articulos.texto:
σύν (old Att. ξύν),
  prep. c. dat.,
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, c. gen. (cf. LS, s.v.; Bl., § 41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mt4, Mk6, Jo3, and elsewhere (exx. Ja 1:11, II Pe 1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Lk 2:13, Jo 21:3, Ac 10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, Lk 7:12, Ac 4:13, Phl 1:23, al.; of partisanship, Ac 4:13; οἱ σύν τινι (ὄντες), of attendants, companions or colleagues, Mk 2:26, Lk 5:9, Ac 5:17, al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, I Co 15:10; of two or more things together, almost = καί, Lk 23:11, Ac 3:4 10:2 14:5 23:15, Eph 3:18; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, II Co 13:4; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, Lk 24:21.
  In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω).

G4496.definicion: to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from G906 (βάλλω), which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from (see in G1614 (ἐκτείνω)), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse

articulos.texto:
ῥίπτω and (Ac 22:23) ῥιπτέω (strengthened form; v. Veitch, s.v. ῥίπτω, fin.),
  [in LXX chiefly for שׁלךְ hi.;]

G4190.definicion_es: dañino, es decir, malo (propiamente, en efecto o influencia, y de ese modo distinto de G2556 (κακός), que se refiere más bien a carácter esencial, así como de G4550 (σαπρός), que indica degeneración de virtud original); figuradamente, calamitoso; también (en pasiva) mal, es decir, enfermo; pero sobre todo (moralmente) culpable, es decir, abandonado, vicioso, neutro facineroso; (singular) daño, malicia, o (plural) culpa; masculino (singular) el diablo, o (plural) pecadores

1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: Mt 8:10, Lk 5:20, Ac 14:9, Ro 1:8, I Co 2:5, II Co 1:24, I Ti 1:5, al.; c. gen. obj., Mk 11:22, Ac 3:16, Ro 3:22, Ga 2:16, Eph 3:12, Ja 2:1, al.; c. prep., ἐν, Ro 3:25, Ga 3:26, Eph 1:15, Col 1:24, I Ti 1:14 3:13, II Ti 1:13
    3:15, II Pe 1:1; εἰς, Ac 20:21 24:24 26:18, Col 2:5, I Pe 1:21; πρός, I Th 1:8, Phm 5; ἐπί, c. acc., He 6:1; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), I Co 16:13, I Co 13:5, I Ti 2:15; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., Ro 1:5 16:26; ὁ ἐκ π., Ro 3:26 4:16, Ga 3:12; διὰ (τῆς) π., Ro 3:30, Ga 2:16, Phl 3:9. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: Ac 6:7 14:22, Ga 1:23 3:23 6:10, Phl 1:25, 27, Ju 3, 20, and perh. also Ac 13:8 16:5, Ro 1:5 and 16:26 (v. supr.), I Co 16:13, Col 1:23, II Th 3:2 (Lft., Notes, 125), I Ti 1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8 6:10, 12, II Ti 3:8 4:7, Tit 1:4, 13 3:15, I Pe 5:9.
2. In passive sense,
   (a) fidelity, faithfulness: Mt 23:23, Ga 5:22; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Ro 3:3;
   (b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: I Ti 5:12. (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, v. esp. ICC on Ro 1:17, pp. 31 ff.; Lft., Ga., 154 ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515 ff.; DB, i, 830 ff.; Cremer, s.v.)

articulos.texto:
περί, prep. c. gen., acc. (in cl. also c. dat.; cf. M, Pr., 105f.),
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides).
   I. C. gen.,
      1. of place, about (poët.).
      2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: Mt 2:8, Mk 1:44, Lk 4:38, Jo 16:26, Ac 28:21, al. mult.; τὰ περί, c. gen., the things concerning one, one's state or case: Mk 5:27, Ac 1:3 28:15, Eph 6:22, al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, I Co 7:1, al.; in the sense on account of (Mt 26:28, I Co 1:13, al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105).
   II. C. acc.,
      1. of place, about, around: Mt 3:4, Mk 1:6, Lk 13:8, Ac 22:6, al.; οἱ περί, c. acc. pers., of one's associates, friends, etc., Mk 4:10, Lk 22:49, Jo 11:19, Ac 13:13; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, Ac 19:25; metaph., about, as to, concerning: I Ti 1:19 6:4, II Ti 2:18 3:8, Tit 2:7; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, Phl 2:23; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, Mk 4:19.
      2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: Mt 20:3, 5, 6, 9 27:46, Mk 6:48, Ac 10:3, 9 22:6.
   III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).

σῶμα, -τος, τό,
  [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה;]
a body.
   1. Prop., of the human body,
      (a) as always in Hom. (opp. to δέμας), of the dead body: Mt 27:58, 59 Mk 15:43, al.;
      (b) of the living body: Lk 11:34, I Co 6:13, al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, He 13:3; as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., II Co 5:10; opp. to πνεῦμα, Ro 8:10, I Co 5:3 7:4, Ja 2:26; to ψυχή, Mt 6:25 10:28, Lk 12:22 (cf. Wi 1:4, al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., I Th 5:23; σ. ψυχικόν, opp. to σ. πνευματικόν, I Co 15:44; ὁ ναὸς τοῦ σ. αὐτοῦ (gen.
epexeg.), Jo 2:21; τὸ σ. τ. ταπεινώσεως ἡμῶν (Hebraistic "gen. of definition"; M, Pr., 73 f.; Bl., §35, 5), opp. to τὸ σ. τ. δοξῆς αὐτοῦ, Phl 3:21; similarly, τὸ σ. τ. σαρκός, Col 1:22; σ. τοῦ θανάτου (subject to death), Ro 7:24; σ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, Ro 6:6;
      (c) periphr., ἀνθρώπου, then absol., σῶμα (Soph., Xen., al.), a person, and in later writers (Polyb., al.), a slave: Re 18:13 (cf. MM, i, ii, xxiv; Deiss., BS, 160).
   2. Of the bodies of animals: living, Ja 3:3; dead, He 13:11 (Ex 29:14, al.).
   3. Of inanimate objects (cf. Eng. "heavenly bodies"): I Co 15:37, 38, 40 (Diod., al.).
   4. Of any corporeal substance (Plat., al.): opp. to σκιά, Col 2:17. Metaph., of a number of persons united by a common bond; in NT, of the Church as the spiritual body of Christ: Ro 12:5, I Co 10:16, 17 12:13, 27, Eph 1:23 2:16 4:4, 12, 16 5:23, 30, Col 1:18, 24 2:19 3:15; ἓν σ. κ. ἓν πνεῦμα, Eph 4:4.

  (< σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Za 13:7; and v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.)
a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: I Th 2:14 (v. M, Th., in l., and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.†

G4632.definicion: a vessel, implement, equipment or apparatus (literally or figuratively [specially, a wife as contributing to the usefulness of the husband])

articulos.texto:
σκεῦος, -ους, τό
  [in LXX chiefly for כְּלִי;]
a vessel, implement (for exx. in various senses, v. MM, xxii): Mk 11:16, Lk 8:16, Jo 19:29, Ac 10:11, 16 11:5, Ro 9:21, Re 18:12; pl., II Ti 2:20, Re 2:27; τὰ σ. τῆς λειτουργίας, He 9:21; pl., τὰ σ., utensils, goods, Mt 12:29, Mk 3:27, Lk 17:31; id. of the tackle or gear of a ship (Xen., Polyb., al.); so in sing., τὸ σ., Ac 27:17. Metaph., of persons: σ. ἐκλογῆς, Ac 9:15; ὀργῆς, Ro 9:22; ἐλέους, ib. 23; σ. εἰς τιμήν (cf. Ro 9:21), II Ti 2:21; of woman, ἀσθενέστερον σ., I Pe 3:7; so perh. τ. ἑαυτοῦ σ., I Th 4:4 (but v. infr.); of the body, II Co 4:7; so perh. I Th 4:4 (but v. supr., and v.s. κτάομαι).†

G4242.definicion: seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors)

articulos.texto:
** πρεσβεία, -ας, ἡ
  (< πρεσβεύω),
  [in LXX: II Mac 4:11*;]
1. age, seniority.
2. rank, dignity.
3. an embassy; by meton., of the ambassadors, embassy: Lk 14:32 19:14.†

Πόντιος, -ου, ὁ,
Pontius, the prænomen of Pilate (v.s. Πειλᾶτος), Mt 27:2 (Rec., WH, mg.), Lk 3:1, Ac 4:27, I Ti 6:13.†

* προσ-οφείλω,
to owe besides: Phm 19 (v. Field, Notes, 225).†

πλούσιος, -α, -ον
  (< πλοῦτος),
  [in LXX chiefly for עָשִׁיר;]
rich, wealthy: Mt 27:57, Lk 12:16 14:12 16:1, 19 18:23 19:2. Substantively, ὁ π., Lk 16:21, 22, Ja 1:10, 11; οἱ π., Lk 6:24 21:1, I Ti 6:17, Ja 2:6 5:1, Re 6:15 13:16; anarth., a rich man, Mt 19:23, 24, Mk 10:25 12:41, Lk 18:25. Metaph., of God, ἐν ἐλέει (= cl., c. gen., dat.), Eph 2:4; of Christ, II Co 8:9; of Christians, Re 2:9 3:17; ἐν πίστει, Ja 2:5.†
articulos.texto_es:
πλούσιος, -α, -ον
  (< πλοῦτος),
  [en LXX sobre todo para עָשִׁיר;]
rico, rico: Mt 27:57, Lk 12:16 14:12 16:1, 19 18:23 19:2. Substantively, ὁ π., Lk 16:21, 22, Ja 1:10, 11; οἱ π., Lk 6:24 21:1, I Ti 6:17, Ja 2:6 5:1, Re 6:15 13:16; sin artículo, un hombre rico, Mt 19:23, 24, Mk 10:25 12:41, Lk 18:25. Metafóricamente, de Dios, ἐν ἐλέει (= en griego clásico, con genitivo, dativo), Eph 2:4; de Cristo, II Co 8:9; de cristianos, Re 2:9 3:17; ἐν πίστει, Ja 2:5.†

articulos.texto:
Σερούχ (Rec. Σαρ-), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. שְׂרוּג),
Serug: Lk 3:35.†
articulos.texto_es:
Σερούχ (Rec. Σαρ-), ὁ, indeclinable (hebreo שְׂרוּג),
Serug: Lk 3:35.†

G4819.origen: de G4862 (σύν) y la raíz de G939 (βάσις)
G4819.definicion: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place)

articulos.glosa: to stand with the feet together
articulos.texto:
συμ-βαίνω
  [in LXX for עשׂה, קרא, קרה, etc.;]
1. to stand with the feet together.
2. to come together, come to terms.
3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: c. dat. pers., Mk 10:32, Ac 3:10 20:19, I Co 10:11, I Pe 4:12, II Pe 2:22; absol., τὰ συμβεβηκότα, Lk 24:14 (cf. I Mac 4:26); c. acc. et inf., Ac 21:35.†
articulos.texto_es:
συμ-βαίνω
  [en LXX para עשׂה, קרא, קרה, etc.;]
1. a estar en pie con el pies juntos.
2. venir juntos, venir a términos.
3. de sucesos, venir a en pasiva, suceder: con dativo de la persona, Mk 10:32, Ac 3:10 20:19, I Co 10:11, I Peal 4:12, II Peal 2:22; absoluto, τὰ συμβεβηκότα, Lk 24:14 (compárese I Mac 4:26); con acusativo y infinitivo, Ac 21:35.†

G4311.definicion: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel
G4311.usos: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth

articulos.texto:
** προ-πέμπω,
  [in LXX: I Es 4:47, Jth 10:15, Wi 19:2, I Mac 12:4, II Mac 6:23*;]
1. to send before, send forth.
2. to set forward on a journey, escort: c. acc. pers., I Co 16:11, Tit 3:13, III Jo 6; seq. εἰς, Ac 20:38; οὗ, I Co 16:6; ἕως, Ac 21:5; pass., Ac 15:3, Ro 15:24, II Co 1:16.†

G4108.definicion: roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader;

articulos.texto:
πλάνος, -ον,
  [in LXX: Jb 19:4 (מְשׁוּגָה), Je 23:32*;]
1. wandering.
2. leading astray, deceiving: πνεύματα π., I Ti 4:1. As subst., ὁ π., a deceiver, impostor: Mt 27:63, II Co 6:8, II Jo 1:7.†

G4208.definicion_es: además, es decir, un mayor distancia

G4625.definicion: a trap-stick (bent sapling), i.e. snare (figuratively, cause of displeasure or sin)
G4625.usos: occasion to fall (of stumbling), offence, thing that offends, stumblingblock

articulos.texto:
† σκάνδαλον, -ου, τό
  (late form of the rare word σκανδάληθρον, v. LS, s.v.)
  [in LXX chiefly for מוֹקֵשׁ, מִכְשׁוֹל;]
prop., the bait-stick of a trap, a snare, stumbling-block (Le 19:14, Jth 5:1): fig., Ro 9:33, I Pe 2:8 (Is 8:14; aliter in LXX; στερεὸν σκανδάλου in Aq.). Metaph., of that which causes error or sin;
(a) of persons: Mt 13:41 16:23; Χριστὸς ἐσταυρωμένος, I Co 1:23;
(b) of things: Mt 18:7, Ro 11:9 (LXX) 14:13, I Jo 2:10 Re 2:14; τὸ σ. τοῦ σταυροῦ, Ga 5:11; pl., Mt 18:7, Lk 17:1, Ro 16:17.†
  SYN.: πρόσκομμα

G4762.origen: reforzada de la raíz de G5157 (τροπή)
G4762.definicion: to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively)
G4762.definicion_es: torcer, es decir, volver del todo alrededor o inverso (literal o figuradamente)
G4762.usos: convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about)

articulos.texto:
στρέφω
  [in LXX chiefly for הפך, also for סבב, etc.;]
to turn: c. acc. rei dat. pers., Mt 5:39; = ἀποσ-, to bring back, Mt 27:3 (cf. Is 38:8); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, Ac 7:42; c. acc. seq. εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, Re 11:6. Pass., reflexive, to turn oneself: seq. εἰς, Jo 20:14, Ac 7:39 13:46; ptcp., στραφείς, c. indic., Mt 7:6 9:22 16:23, Lk 7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61, Jo 1:38 20:16; id. seq. πρός, Lk 7:44 10:22 (WH, R, om.), ib. 23 23:28; metaph., to change: absol., Mt 18:3, Jo 12:40 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).†
articulos.texto_es:
στρέφω
  [en LXX sobre todo para הפך, también para סבב, etc.;]
volver: con acusativo de la cosa dativo de la persona, Mt 5:39; = ἀποσ-, hacer volver, Mt 27:3 (compárese es 38:8); reflexivamente (WM, § 38, 1), volver a sí mismo, Ac 7:42; con acusativo seguido de εἰς, = μετασ-, cambiar, Re 11:6. pasar., reflexivo, volver a sí mismo: seguido de εἰς, Jo 20:14, Ac 7:39 13:46; participio, στραφείς, con indicativo, Mt 7:6 9:22 16:23, Lk 7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61, Jo 1:38 20:16; ídem seguido de πρός, Lk 7:44 10:22 (WH, R , omite), ibídem 23 23:28; metafóricamente, cambiar: absoluto, Mt 18:3, Jo 12:40 (compárese ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).†

articulos.texto:
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ
  (< συγγενής),
  [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה;]
1. kinship.
2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: Lk 1:61, Ac 7:3, 14 †
articulos.texto_es:
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ
  (< συγγενής),
  [en LXX sobre todo para מִשְׁפָּחָה;]
1. parentesco.
2. por metonimia., parentela, parentela: Lk 1:61, Ac 7:3, 14 †

G4965.definicion: Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine
G4965.definicion_es: Sychar (es decir, Shekar), un lugar de Palestina

articulos.texto:
Συχάρ
  (Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ,
Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jo 4:5.†
articulos.texto_es:
Συχάρ
  (Ε, Σιχάρ), indeclinable, ἡ,
Sychar, un pueblo de Samaria: Jo 4:5.†

G4599.definicion: probably akin to the base of G2476 (ἵστημι)); to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power)
G4599.definicion_es: probablemente afín al base de G2476 (ἵστημι)); fortalecer, es decir, (figuradamente) confirmar (en conocimiento espiritual y poder)

articulos.texto:
*† σθενόω, -ῶ
  (< σθένος, strength),
to strengthen: c. acc., I Pe 5:10 (Hesych.).†
articulos.texto_es:
*† σθενόω, -ῶ
  (< σθένος, fuerza),
fortalecer: con acusativo, I Peal 5:10 ( Hesych .).†

G4737.definicion: to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively)

articulos.texto:
στεφανόω, -ῶ
  (< στέφανος),
  [in LXX for עטר;]
c. acc. pers.,
to crown: of a victor, II Ti 2:5. Metaph., δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, He 2:7, 9 (LXX).†

G4469.definicion: O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification)
G4469.definicion_es: O vacío uno, es decir, tú sin valor (como término de proferir vituperio)

articulos.texto:
* ῥακά (T, ῥαχά),
usually taken to represent the Aram. רֵיקָא, a shortened form of רֵיקָן, "empty," as vocalized in the Galilæan dialect; an expression of contempt, raca: Mt 5:22 (cf. DB, iv, 191 f.; and for other explanations, v. Zorell, s.v.).†

G4184.origen: de G4183 (πολύς) y G4698 (σπλάγχνον) (en sentido figurado)

articulos.texto:
*† πολύσπλαγχνος, -ον
  (< πολύς, σπλάγχνον),
very pitiful: Ja 5:11.†

σῦκον, -ου, τό
  [in LXX for תְּאֵנָה]
a fig: Mt 7:16, Mk 11:13, Lk 6:44 Ja 3:12.†
articulos.texto_es:
σῦκον, -ου, τό
  [en LXX para תְּאֵנָה]
un figuradamente: Mt 7:16, Mk 11:13, Lk 6:44 Ja 3:12.†

articulos.texto:
σάλπιγξ, -ιγγος, ἡ
  [in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹפָר, חֲצֹצְרָה;]
a trumpet, used in war and in religious ceremonies: I Co 14:8, He 12:19, Re 1:10 4:1 8:2, 6, 13 9:14 By meton., a trumpet blast: μετὰ σ. μεγάλης, Mt 24:31; ἐν σ. θεοῦ, I Th 4:16; ἐν τ. ἐσχάτῃ σ., I Co 15:52.†

πόνος, -ου, ὁ
  [in LXX for עָמָל, etc.;]
1. labour, toil: Col 4:13.
2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): Re 16:10, 11 21:4.†
  SYN.: v.s. κόπος.
articulos.texto_es:
πόνος, -ου, ὁ
  [en LXX para עָמָל, etc.;]
1. trabajo, afanarse: Col 4:13.
2. la consecuencia de afanarse, angustia, padecimiento, dolor (Xen., y otros, LXX): Re 16:10, 11 21:4.†
  SINÓNIMOS: véase arriba κόπος.

G4936.origen: de G4862 (σύν) y G5143 (τρέχω) (incluido su alternativa)
G4936.definicion: to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively)
G4936.definicion_es: precipitarse juntos (de prisa reunir) o de cabeza (figuradamente)

articulos.texto:
συν-τρέχω
  [in LXX: Ps 49 (50):18 (עִם רָצָה), II Mac 2, Jdt 4 *;]
to run together or with: seq. ἐκεῖ, Mk 6:33; πρόσ, c. acc., Ac 3:11; metaph., I Pe 4:4.†
articulos.texto_es:
συν-τρέχω
  [en LXX: Ps 49 (50):18 (עִם רָצָה), II Mac 2, Jdt 4 *;]
correr juntos o con: seguido de ἐκεῖ, Mk 6:33; πρόσ, con acusativo, Ac 3:11; metafóricamente, I Peal 4:4.†

G4106.definicion: objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety

articulos.texto:
πλάνη, -ης, ἡ,
  [in LXX: Pr 14:8 (מִרְמָה), Wi 1:12, al;]
a wandering. Metaph., a going astray, an error (in NT always with respect to morals or religion): Mt 27:64, Ro 1:27, Eph 4:14, I Th 2:3, II Th 2:11, Ja 5:20, II Pe 2:18 3:17, I Jo 4:6, Ju 11.†

G4642.definicion: dry, i.e. hard or tough (figuratively, harsh, severe)
G4642.definicion_es: seco, es decir, duro o duro (figuradamente, áspero, severo)

articulos.texto:
σκληρός, -ά, -όν
  (< σκέλλω, to dry),
  [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה;]
hard to the touch, rough, harsh, (opp. to μαλακός); metaph., in various uses;
(a) of men, hard, stern, severe: Mt 25:24;
(b) of things, hard, rough, violent: σκληρόν σοι (ἐστι), Ac 26:14; λόγος, Jo 6:60; ἄνεμος, Ja 3:4; σκληρὰ λαλεῖν, Ju 15.†
  SYN.: αὐστηρός, q.v

G4358.definicion: to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at

articulos.texto:
* προσ-ορμίζω
  (< ὅρμος, an anchorage),
to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): Mk 6:53.†

σποδός, -οῦ, ὁ
  [in LXX chiefly for אֵפֶר;]
ashes: He 9:13; ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. (Is 58:5, Jo 3:6, Da LXX 9:3, al.), Mt 11:21, Lk 10:13.†
articulos.texto_es:
σποδός, -οῦ, ὁ
  [en LXX sobre todo para אֵפֶר;]
ceniza: él 9:13; ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. (es 58:5, Jo 3:6, Da LXX 9:3, y otros), Mt 11:21, Lk 10:13.†

articulos.texto:
ποίησις, -εως, ἡ
  (ποιέω),
  [in LXX chiefly for מַעֲשֶׂה and cognate forms;]
1. a making (Hdt., Thuc., al.).
2. a doing (Si 19:18 51:19): Ja 1:25.†
articulos.texto_es:
ποίησις, -εως, ἡ
  (ποιέω),
  [en LXX sobre todo para מַעֲשֶׂה y cognado formas;]
1. un hacer (Hdt., Thuc., y otros)
2. un hacer (Si 19:18 51:19): Ja 1:25.†

G4333.definicion: to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides
G4333.definicion_es: trabajar además, es decir, (por implicación) adquirir además

articulos.texto:
* προσ-εργάζομαι,
1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.).
2. to gain besides, by working or trading: Lk 19:16 (Xen.).†

G4243.definicion: to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher)
G4243.definicion_es: ser un mayor, es decir, (por implicación) acto como representante (figuradamente, predicador)

articulos.texto:
* πρεσβεύω
  (< πρέσβυς),
1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
2. to be an ambassador (v.s. πρεσβύτης): II Co 5:20, Eph 6:20.†

G4223.definicion: little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy

articulos.texto:
Ποτίολοι, -ων, οἱ,
Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: Ac 28:13.†

G4489.definicion: a speaker, i.e. (by implication) a forensic advocate
G4489.definicion_es: un orador, es decir, (por implicación) un abogado forense

articulos.texto:
* ῥήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
a public speaker, an orator: Ac 24:1.†

G4714.definicion: a standing (properly, the act), i.e. (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy

articulos.texto:
στάσις, -εως, ἡ
  (< ἵστημι),
  [in LXX chiefly for עמד, its parts and derivatives, also for רִיב (Pr 17:14), etc. (v. Deiss., BS, 158 f.);]
1. a standing, place, status: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), He 9:8.
2. insurrection, sedition: Mk 15:7, Lk 23:19, 25, Ac 19:40 24:5.
3. In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) Ac 15:2 23:7, 10.†

G4686.definicion: a coil (spira, "spire"), i.e. (figuratively) a mass of men (a Roman military cohort; also (by analogy) a squad of Levitical janitors)

articulos.texto:
** σπείρα, -ης
  (on this form of gen., v. M, Pr., 38, 48; Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, 12; Deiss., BS, 186),
  [in LXX: Jth 14:11, II Mac 8:23 12:20, 22 *;]
1. (= Lat. spira) anything or rolled up, a coil.
2. As a military term used (by Polyb. and later writers) of a body of soldiers, a maniple (third part of a cohort) or cohort (v. Swete, Mk., 375; Westc., Jo., 251 f.): Mt 27:27, Mk 15:16, Jo 18:3, 12, Ac 10:1 21:31 27:1.†

G4189.definicion: depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins

articulos.texto:
πονηρία, -ας, ἡ
  (< πονηρός),
  [in LXX chiefly for רָעָה;]
iniquity, wickedness: Mt 22:18, Lk 11:39, Ro 1:29, Eph 6:12; pl. (v. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), Mk 7:22, Ac 3:26; κακία καὶ π., I Co 5:8.†
  SYN.: v.s. κακία.
articulos.texto_es:
πονηρία, -ας, ἡ
  (< πονηρός),
  [en LXX sobre todo para רָעָה;]
iniquidad, maldad: Mt 22:18, Lk 11:39, Ro 1:29, Eph 6:12; plural (véase Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), Mk 7:22, Ac 3:26; κακία καὶ π., I Co 5:8.†
  SINÓNIMOS: véase arriba κακία.

G4086.origen: de un compuesto de un derivado de G3982 (πείθω) y G3056 (λόγος)

articulos.texto:
* πιθανολογία, -ας, ἡ
  (< πιθανός, persuasive, plausible), in cl. (Plat),
the use of probable arguments, as opp. to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, persuasive speech: Col 2:4 (v. ICC, in l.).†

G4435.definicion: the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing)

articulos.texto:
πυγμή, -ῆς, ἡ,
  [in LXX: Ex 21:18, Is 58:4 (אֶגְרוֹף)*;]
the fist: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χεῖρας (T, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), to wash the hands with the fist (diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; v. Swete, in l.): Mk 7:3.†

G4439.definicion: a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively)

articulos.texto:
πύλη, -ης, ἡ,
  [in LXX chiefly and very freq. for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח;]
a gate: Lk 7:12, Ac 9:24 12:10 16:13, He 13:12; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, Ac 3:10. Metaph., Mt 7:13, 14; πύλαι ᾅδου (Wi 16:13, III Mac 5:51, and cf. κλεῖς ᾅδου, Re 1:18): Mt 16:18.†
articulos.texto_es:
πύλη, -ης, ἡ,
  [en LXX sobre todo y muy frecuente para שַׁעַר a veces para דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח;]
una puerta: Lk 7:12, Ac 9:24 12:10 16:13, él 13:12; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, Ac 3:10. Metafóricamente, Mt 7:13, 14; πύλαι ᾅδου (Wi 16:13, III Mac 5:51, y compárese κλεῖς ᾅδου, Re 1:18): Mt 16:18.†

articulos.texto:
στῆθος, -ους, τό
  [in LXX: Ex 28:23, 26 (29, 30) (לֵב), etc.;]
the breast: Jo 13:25 21:10, Re 15:6; as a sign of penitence, τύπτειν (εἰς) τὸ σ., Lk 18:13 23:48,†

πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
  (< πραγματεύομαι),
  [in LXX for חֵשֶׁל, etc.;]
1. careful application, hard work.
2. business, occupation: pl., II Ti 2:4.†

πιέζω,
  [in LXX: Mi 6:15 (דּרךְ)*;]
1. to press, press down or together: Lk 6:38 (cl).
2. Later, to seize (v.s. πιάζω).†
articulos.texto_es:
πιέζω,

G4716.definicion: a stake or post (as set upright), i.e. (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e. self-denial; by implication, the atonement of Christ

articulos.texto:
* σταυρός, -οῦ, ὁ
1. an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.)
2. In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, the Cross: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, Mt 27:32, 40, 42, Mk 15:21, 30, 32, Lk 23:26, Jo 19:17, 19, 25, 31, Col 2:14, He 12:2; θάνατος σταυροῦ, Phl 2:8; τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., Col 1:20. Metaph., in proverbial sayings: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., Mt 10:38 16:24, Mk 8:34 10:21, 15:21, Lk 9:23 14:27 (for an interesting ex. of metaph. use in π., v. MM, xxiii) By meton., for Christ's death on the Cross: I Co 1:17, Ga 5:11 6:12, 14, Eph 2:16, Phl 3:18; ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σ., I Co 1:18.†

G4679.definicion: to render wise; in a sinister acceptation, to form "sophisms", i.e. continue plausible error

articulos.texto_es:

G4873.definicion: to recline in company with (at a meal)

articulos.texto:

  [in LXX: III Mac 5:39 *;]
to recline with or together at table: Mt 14:9, Mk 6:22, Lk 7:49 14:15; c. dat. pers., Mt 9:10, Mk 2:15, Lk 14:10.†
articulos.texto_es:
**† συν-ανά-κειμαι
  [en LXX: III Mac 5:39 *;]
recostarse con o juntos en mesa: Mt 14:9, Mk 6:22, Lk 7:49 14:15; con dativo de la persona, Mt 9:10, Mk 2:15, Lk 14:10.†

G4957.definicion: to impale in company with (literally or figuratively)

G4022.origen: de G4012 (περί) y G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (incluido su alternativa)

περι-έρχομαι,

to go about (as an itinerant): Ac 19:13 28:13 (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), He 11:37; τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: I Ti 5:13.†

πῦρ, gen., πυρός, τό,
  [in LXX chiefly and very freq. for אֵשׁ;]
fire: Mk 9:22, Lk 3:9, Jo 15:6, Ac 2:19, I Co 3:13, Ja 3:5, Re 8:5, al; π. καὶ θεῖον, Lk 17:29; κατακαίειν (ἐν) π., Mt 13:40, Re 17:16 18:8; καίεσθαι πυρί, He 12:18, Re 8:8 21:8; φλὸξ πυρός, Ac 7:30, II Th 1:8, He 1:7, Re 1:14 2:18 19:12; λαμπάδες πυρός, Re 4:5; στῦλοι πυρός, Re 10:1; ἄνθρακες πυρός, Ro 12:20(LXX); γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, Ac 2:3; δοκιμάζειν (πυροῦσθαι) διὰ πυρός, I Pe 1:7, Re 3:18; ὡς διὰ. π. (Lft., Notes, 193), I Co 3:15. Of the fire of hell (cf. Dalman, Words,161): Mk 9:48(LXX); τὸ π. τὸ αἰώνιον, Mt 18:8 25:41 (cf. IV Mac 12:12); ἄσβεστον, Mk 9:43; πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχειν, Ju 7; γέεννα τοῦ π., Mt 5:22 18:9; κάμινος τοῦ π., Mt 13:42, 50; ἡ λίμνη τοῦ π., Re 19:20 20:10, 14, 15; πυρὶ τηρεῖσθαι, II Pe 3:7; βασανισθῆναι ἐν π., Re 14:10. Metaph.: βαπτίζειν πυρί, Mt 3:11, Lk 3:16; of the tongue, Ja 3:5; of strife and discord, Lk 12:49; ἐκ π. ἁρπάζειν, Ju 23; πυρὶ ἁλίζεσθαι, Mk 9:49; ζῆλος πυρός, He 10:27; of God, π. καταναλίσκον, He 12:29(LXX).

G4817.definicion: to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate
G4817.definicion_es: contar juntos (con a sí mismo), es decir, deliberar

συλ-λογίζομαι

1. to compute.

G4064.definicion: to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither

περι-φέρω,

to carry about: Mk 6:55, II Co 4:10. Pass., metaph.: Eph 4:14.†

G4990.definicion: a deliverer, i.e. God or Christ

articulos.texto:
σωτήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ
  (< σώζω),
  [in LXX for יֵשַׁע and cognate forms;]
saviour, deliverer, preserver, a freq. epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT,
(a) of God (as LXX: Ps 23 (24):5, Is 12:2, al.): Lk 1:47, I Ti 1:1 2:3 4:10, Tit 1:3 2:10 3:4, Ju 25;
(b) of Christ: Lk 2:11, Ac 5:31 13:23, Phl 3:20; τ. κόσμου, Jo 4:42, I Jo 4:14 (for the general use of the word, v. Westc., in l.); ἡμῶν, II Ti 1:10, Tit 1:4 3:6; θεὸς (κύριος) καὶ σ. (v. Deiss., LAE, 3484; M, Pr., 84), Tit 2:13, II Pe 1:1, 11 2:20 3:2, 18; σ. τοῦ σώματος (i.e. of the Church; v.s. σῶμα, 5), Eph 5:23.†

G4903.definicion: to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate

articulos.texto:
** συνεργέω, -ῶ
  [in LXX: I Es 7:2, I Mac 12:1 *;]
1. prop., to work together (with): absol., Mk 16:[20], I Co 16:16, II Co 6:1; c. dat., Ja 2:22; dat. commod., Ro 8:28, T, R, txt. (but v. infr.).
2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l.): c. acc. rei, Ro 8:28 [WH] R, mg. (but v. supr.).†
articulos.texto_es:
** συνεργέω, -ῶ
  [en LXX: I Es 7:2, I Mac 12:1 *;]
1. puntal., trabajar juntos (con): absoluto, Mk 16:[20], I Co 16:16, II Co 6:1; con dativo, Ja 2:22; dativo de provecho, Ro 8:28, T , R , texto (pero véase abajo).
2. en Hellenistic escritores( M , Pr., 65), transitivo, causar trabajar juntos (compárese ICC, en l .): con acusativo de la cosa, Ro 8:28 [WH] R , margen (pero véase arriba .).†

Metaph., of experience of divine providence; of prosperity (Ps 15 (16):5, al.); of adversity (Ps 10 (11):6, Is 51:17, al.): of the sufferings of Christ, Mt 20:22, 23 26:39 10:38, 39 14:36, Lk 22:42, Jo 18:11; of divine punishment, Re 14:10 16:19 18:6.†

articulos.texto_es:

2. (menos frecuente en en griego clásico), un presente, una ofrenda; en NT, de ofrendas sacrificiales: Ac 21:26 24:17, Eph 5:2, él 10:5, 8, 14; περί ἁμαρτίας, él 10:18; con genitivo objeto, Ro 15:16, él 10:10.†
